claim.summary: For v Boolean variables, U=V_K and s coordinate features, the length-h feature-word space has basis x_R with |R|<=K+h and |R minus E|<=K. Its dimension is sum_(j<=min(K,v-s)) binom(v-s,j) sum_(i<=min(s,K+h-j)) binom(s,i). Adding one feature for h>=1 increases dimension by binom(v-s-1,K) sum_(i<=min(s,h-1))binom(s,i), zero once v-s<=K.
claim.assessment: All-parameter exact Boolean monomial count, including cutoff saturation. Independent feature matroid elements can add no dimension because the multiplier space already supplies them. This is a filtration calibration, not a hard-source or lower-bound obstruction.
